Next we will test the impact of installing terraces on the landscape. Using Table 16.5, determine the Pt factor. When terraces are installed, contour tillage is usually used as well. Also, note that installing a terrace results in a shorter length of the slope (because the terrace stops water from continuing to run down slope), so this calculation is performed for each terrace individually. Also note that the net P factor is determined by multiplying the Pc and Pt values together, or writing the RUSLE as follows: $$ A4 = R \times K \times LS \times P_c \times P_t $$ ## Table 16.5.
